spec.description: How accurate past hourly temperature and precipitation (rain plus snow) forecasts have been: forecast-minus-actual error by lead time over the selected range (melon location, openweathermap exporter). Normal: temperature RMSE ~2-2.5 °C at 6-24 h lead and ~1.5 °C at 47 h; mean error within ±0.6 °C. Precipitation RMSE ~1-1.5 mm at 3-47 h lead (event-driven; dominated by rain hours).

spec.expr: (openweathermap_forecast_temperature_celsius{forecast_type="hourly", offset_hours="6"} offset 6h) - on(job, instance) openweathermap_current_temperature_celsius
(openweathermap_forecast_temperature_celsius{forecast_type="hourly", offset_hours="12"} offset 12h) - on(job, instance) openweathermap_current_temperature_celsius
(openweathermap_forecast_temperature_celsius{forecast_type="hourly", offset_hours="24"} offset 24h) - on(job, instance) openweathermap_current_temperature_celsius
(openweathermap_forecast_temperature_celsius{forecast_type="hourly", offset_hours="47"} offset 47h) - on(job, instance) openweathermap_current_temperature_celsius
vector(0)

spec.description: Forecast minus actual by lead time. Positive episodes mean forecasts ran warm; the gray line is zero.

spec.expr: sum_over_time(((sum by (job, instance) (openweathermap_current_rain_depth_meters + openweathermap_current_snow_depth_meters) >= bool 0.0001) * on(job, instance) (sum by (job, instance) (openweathermap_forecast_rain_depth_meters{forecast_type="hourly", offset_hours="$forecast_lead"} offset ${forecast_lead}h + openweathermap_forecast_snow_depth_meters{forecast_type="hourly", offset_hours="$forecast_lead"} offset ${forecast_lead}h) >= bool 0.0001))[$__range:1h])

spec.description: Confusion matrix for precipitation of at least 0.1 mm/h (rain or snow) at the selected lead over the selected range: rows are actual, columns are forecast. This cell: precipitation in both.
spec.title: Precipitation Hit

spec.expr: sum_over_time(((sum by (job, instance) (openweathermap_current_rain_depth_meters + openweathermap_current_snow_depth_meters) >= bool 0.0001) * on(job, instance) (sum by (job, instance) (openweathermap_forecast_rain_depth_meters{forecast_type="hourly", offset_hours="$forecast_lead"} offset ${forecast_lead}h + openweathermap_forecast_snow_depth_meters{forecast_type="hourly", offset_hours="$forecast_lead"} offset ${forecast_lead}h) < bool 0.0001))[$__range:1h])

spec.description: Hours with actual precipitation (0.1 mm/h or more) that the forecast at the selected lead called dry.
spec.title: Precipitation Miss

spec.expr: sum_over_time(((sum by (job, instance) (openweathermap_current_rain_depth_meters + openweathermap_current_snow_depth_meters) < bool 0.0001) * on(job, instance) (sum by (job, instance) (openweathermap_forecast_rain_depth_meters{forecast_type="hourly", offset_hours="$forecast_lead"} offset ${forecast_lead}h + openweathermap_forecast_snow_depth_meters{forecast_type="hourly", offset_hours="$forecast_lead"} offset ${forecast_lead}h) >= bool 0.0001))[$__range:1h])

spec.description: Hours the forecast at the selected lead called wet (0.1 mm/h or more) but the actual stayed under 0.1 mm/h.
spec.title: Precipitation False Alarm

spec.expr: sum_over_time(((sum by (job, instance) (openweathermap_current_rain_depth_meters + openweathermap_current_snow_depth_meters) < bool 0.0001) * on(job, instance) (sum by (job, instance) (openweathermap_forecast_rain_depth_meters{forecast_type="hourly", offset_hours="$forecast_lead"} offset ${forecast_lead}h + openweathermap_forecast_snow_depth_meters{forecast_type="hourly", offset_hours="$forecast_lead"} offset ${forecast_lead}h) < bool 0.0001))[$__range:1h])
